name: io.github.sepehr071/balad-mcp
title: Balad Maps
description: Read-only Balad (balad.ir) Iran map: places nearby or on the way, details, reviews, driving routes.

environmentVariables.name: BALAD_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for the Balad requests; system proxy settings are ignored. Also accepts a comma-separated list: one is used until it gets blocked or fails to connect, then the next.
